libraryDeployment: S0ULActionCodec uses internal pure functions and is included in the controller compilation; no separate library deployment is submitted.

procedure.action: Read frozen build and CLI compiler input; verify all source SHA-256 values match the exact source files.
Recompile the CLI standard input with the pinned compiler; compare ABI, creation bytecode and runtime bytecode with the controller build.
Create a standard compiler input containing only the controller and its internal library. Recompile and require the target ABI and both bytecodes to match the frozen controller artifact exactly.

After the root agent confirms deployment, require a complete successful chain4663 controller journal. Encode the constructor arguments and verify the creation-code Keccak256 against the recorded deployment calldata hash.
Submit the exact standard compiler input, compilerVersion, contractIdentifier and creationTransactionHash to the public Sourcify v2 endpoint.
Poll the returned verificationId using bounded requests. Record exact creation/runtime matches or the actual pending/failure status, without resubmitting an ambiguous request.

scope: Public source verification only. No wallet, signing, transaction broadcast, chain RPC, or GitHub modification.
